thread:
Elena (AE): Quick heads-up — Peridot started the POC today. Legal flagged model provenance & variant guarantees; need compatibility checklist before infra handoff.
Sam R.: Their eng asks: 1) custom llama30b quant variant support, 2) KV-cache persistence across warmups, 3) p50 <120ms at 4k prompt length.
Anya (Solutions): Also want embedding-drift evals on our quant variant. Can we produce a recommended quant/profile matrix?
Marco (Infra): Ran a perf pass on a similar build: q4_k_mixed on A10G => ~95ms p50 at 2k prompts batch=4. At 4k it increases; continuous batching tuning needed.
Sam R.: Catalog gating: (A) artifact SHA + upstream repo/tokenizer, (B) compatibility manifest for quantized variants listing supported kernels.
Elena (AE): Legal question: can we host their custom variant in our catalog or must it stay customer-only? Owen?
Owen (Security): License looks permissive but require signed attestation if forked. Add question to questionnaire: 'Is this an unmodified upstream model? (Y/N)' If N -> escalate to Risk for IP review. KMS required for Private.
Anya (Solutions): Proposed eval prompt sets: docs summarization, multi-turn with context injections, embedding similarity on ~10k rows. Need model pinning for repeatable runs.
Marco (Infra): Suggest catalog variant entry: 
``nmodel: peridot/llama30b-custom
version: peridot-2026-03-18
quant: q4_k_mixed
kernels: [cuda_attention_v2, fused_mlp]
```
Need their artifact URL (S3/HF).
Sam R.: KV cache note: runtime has ephemeral per-worker cache; persistence across restarts requires prefix cache + Redis. If they want warm starts, enable prefix_cache and share config.
Elena (AE): Pricing: does quant change price tiers?
Marco (Infra): Yes — quant lowers mem so we can fit ~1.5x concurrent contexts. Recommend 15% discount on per-token for q4_k variants for committed POC capacity (pricing approval required).
Elena (AE): I'll loop pricing. Remaining blockers?
Owen (Security): Additions: SLA must reference model provenance; customer must complete model-supply-chain questionnaire. I'll review answers within 48h of receipt.
InfraBot: model-supply-chain checklist created: https://intranet.redwood/models/checklist/PRD-44321 (assigned to Peridot contact).
Anya (Solutions): Action list: 1) ask for artifact link + SHA, 2) confirm catalog hosting permissions, 3) deliver quant/profile matrix + perf targets, 4) get pricing approval for q4_k discount.
Sam R.: I'll draft a compatibility manifest and runtime flags note. Draft snippet: 
``ncompatibility_manifest:
  model_id: peridot/llama30b-custom
  supported_quant: [q8_0, q4_k_mixed]
  supported_kernels: [fused_attention_v2, fused_mlp]
  min_gpu_mem_gb: 24
  recommended_batch: 4
  prefix_cache: redis://10.0.0.5:6379
```
Elena (AE): ETA for internal deliverables?
Marco (Infra): Perf rerun + infra config by EOD tomorrow.
Sam R.: Manifest draft by noon tomorrow.
Owen (Security): Questionnaire review within 48h of receipt.
Elena (AE): Great, thanks all. I'll post Peridot replies here. :thumbsup:
